title: microlepia polyantha

It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
